purpose: Paper-inspired diagnostic of command-interface sensitivity on one identical neutral observation. This is secondary evidence and cannot substitute for closed-loop success.

source.layout: wrist 640x360 on top; left and right exterior cameras each 320x180 on bottom

grounding.method: Exact RoboLab pinhole intrinsics and extrinsics project simulator ground-truth centroids into the actual source image; coordinates are frozen before model requests.

conditions.prompt: Put the rubiks cube to the left of the bowl
Put the rubiks cube to the left of the bowl
Place the multicolored cube on the table on the bowl's left side
Put the rubiks cube to the right of the bowl
Reach for and firmly grasp the rubiks cube
Move the gripper through left-camera pixel points [(859,181), (828,286), (797,391), (767,495)]
Grasp the rubiks cube at left-camera image point [767,495]
Place the rubiks cube at left-camera image point [617,482]
Place the rubiks cube at left-camera image point [779,384]
Move left from gripper point [859,181] to the rubiks cube at [767,495], firmly grasp it, then follow [(767,495), (717,491), (667,486), (617,482)]
Move right from gripper point [859,181] to the rubiks cube at [767,495], firmly grasp it, then follow [(767,495), (771,458), (775,421), (779,384)]
Put the banana to the left of the bowl
Put the rubiks cube to both the left and the right of the bowl at the same time

shared: action effect relative to exact-repeat noise
wam_only: future pixel MAE versus canonical task
semantic future labels from the frozen prompt-blind scorer where applicable
reporting.claim_boundary: Distances measure sensitivity. Correct steerability requires directionally appropriate closed-loop behavior or a reliable semantic future predicate.
